title: On Attending the meeting in the cold hall
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：attend　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 attend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the ranger ① attended the meeting in the cold hall before dawn, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the ranger ② attends the meeting in the cold hall in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ attend the meeting in the cold hall at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ attended the meeting in the cold hall before — a line in the survey for October 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Attending the meeting in the cold hall before dawn, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ attend my uncle through the fever in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Attend my uncle through the fever at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the survey, and a new villager from the next valley ⑧ attends my uncle through the fever before dawn every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ridge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ attended the meeting in the cold hall again when nobody else would.

⑩ To attend the meeting in the cold hall, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody attends the meeting in the cold hall in public again and somebody must attend the meeting in the cold hall before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 出席（一般过去式 attended the meeting in the cold hall：1982 年守林人头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 出席（一般现在 attends the meeting in the cold hall：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 出席（不定式 to attend the meeting in the cold hall：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 出席（过去完成时 had attended the meeting in the cold hall：1976 年十月的踏勘记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 出席（动名词 attending the meeting in the cold hall 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 照料（attend my uncle through the fever：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去照料发烧的叔叔整个病期）
G. v. 照料（attend my uncle through the fever：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 出席（后段两处：新来的村民照例 attends my uncle through the fever，而母亲又一次 attended the meeting in the cold hall）

answers.why: attend 意为“出席”，1982 年守林人天没亮就出席在冰冷的大厅里开的会，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 attended。
attend 意为“出席”，自那以后守林人当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 attends。
attend 意为“出席”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯出席在冰冷的大厅里开的会”，此处为不定式 to attend the meeting in the cold hall。
attend 意为“出席”，踏勘记录里 十月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人出席过，故用过去完成时 had attended。
attend 意为“出席”，守林人说“出席在冰冷的大厅里开的会这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 attending the meeting in the cold hall 作主语。
attend 意为“照料”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去照料发烧的叔叔整个病期”，should ever 之后用原形 attend my uncle through the fever。
attend 意为“照料”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻照料发烧的叔叔整个病期（attend my uncle through the fever at once），以后再也不要提起。
attend 意为“出席”，新来的村民每个季节都照例照料发烧的叔叔整个病期，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 attends。
attend 意为“出席”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就出席在冰冷的大厅里开的会，用一般过去式 attended 叙述。
attend 意为“出席”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要出席在冰冷的大厅里开的会，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 attend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the ranger attended the meeting in the cold hall before dawn, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the ranger attends the meeting in the cold hall in public whenever the valley asks.
Attending the meeting in the cold hall before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever attend my uncle through the fever in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new villager from the next valley attends my uncle through the fever before dawn every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother attended the meeting in the cold hall again, and the valley remembered that half.
